Results.ReviewText: While I was initially concerned as to whether there was enough cooking surface with this grill as our previous one of a different brand had more, I have bound the surface to be more than adequate. We buy lots of meat in bulk and pre-cook it on the grill. Unlike the other brand, literally every square inch is perfect cooking surface. The heavy ceramic covered grates are also easy to clean between uses. The spring-loaded tank "gauge" is a good heads up of approximately how much propane is left in the tank. The burners are hot enough that I seldom use them on high. AWESOME GRILL!!
Results.Title: Great Grill with 100% of Cooking Surface Usable

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I have not had a chance to use my new Weber grill because it has been so cold, windy and rainy in Columbus, Ohio! 

I did buy the grill unassembled and started assembling the in the garage on nice afternoons. I was impressed on the packaging of the product, the engineering of the pieces and clarity of the directions! I also downloaded the BILT app. 

This was a nice project for me while staying home. I am 67 years old and just realized my dexterity is not what it was back in my younger years, so it took me more than 1.30 hours to complete. 

I added several accessories and purchased the Weber's Way to Grill book. Best grilling book I have ever come across!

Looking forward to better weather and a chance to grill out on my new gas grill. I also own two Weber charcoal kettle grills that I have used for many years!
Results.Title: Perfect size grill for a couple

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit II E-310 gas grill was my first Weber grill, and it was a little more complex to assemble than other grills I have owned. When using it, I notice that although there are three burners, the grill gets very hot quickly, and I have to cook items at a lower setting. 45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
